question: Which of the following climate type is common to southern California, central Chile and southern tip of Africa?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 50/2025 (Divisional Accountant, 10 May 2025). The correct answer is Mediterranean climate.

question: The percent of world’s fresh water availability is in the order (higher to lower) :
options: Groundwater > Lakes and rivers > Polar ice
Polar ice > Ground water > Lakes and rivers
Polar ice > Lakes and rivers > Ground water
Oceans > Ground water > Lakes and rivers
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 024/2024 (Range Forest Officer, 16 Feb 2024). The correct answer is Polar ice > Ground water > Lakes and rivers.

question: Consider the following national Parks and States. Which of the following is/are correctly matched? National Parks States (i) Sariska National Park (1) Assam (ii) Madhav National Park (2) Uttarkhand (iii) Kaziranga National Park (3) Rajasthan (iv) Corbett National Park (4) Madhya Pradesh
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 193/2023 (Non Vocational Teacher in General Foundation Course, 4 Oct 2023). The correct answer is (i)-(3), (ii)-(4), (iii)-(1), (iv)-(2).

question: Consider the following statements about El Nino. Which of the following is/are correct? (i) It is a warm ocean conditions (ii) It is indicated by sea surface temperature increase of more than 10° C (iii) The name El Nino was originally used by the fishermen of northern peru (iv) The timing and intensity of El Nino events never vary widely
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 193/2023 (Non Vocational Teacher in General Foundation Course, 4 Oct 2023). The correct answer is Only (i) and (iii).

question: The tide which occurs when the earth, sun and moon are in line with each other is:
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 053/2026 (Fisheries Officer, 3 Jun 2026). The correct answer is Spring tide.

question: Select the correct statement about Tehri Dam. (i) The dam is situated in Uttarakhand and it is built on Alakananda river. (ii) This dam is considered as the tallest Dam in India built on Narmada river. (iii) This dam was built on Bhageerathi river in Uttarakhand. (iv) It is a multi purpose dam and considered as the largest earthen dam in India. (v) Environmentalists like Sunderlal Bahuguna and Virendra Dutt Saklani pointed out the environmental consequences of the project.
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 138/2025 (Divisional Accounts Officer, 29 Oct 2025). The correct answer is Option (iii) and (v).

question: The Earth is not a perfect sphere but an oblate spheroid. Which of the following best explains why the equatorial radius of the Earth is greater than the polar radius?
options: The Earth’s crust is thicker at the equator than at the poles
Gravitational force is stronger at the equator, pulling the surface outward
The Earth’s rotation causes centrifugal force, which is maximum at the equator
Tidal forces from the Moon pull the Earth outward along the equator
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 134/2025 (Junior Geophysicist, 24 Oct 2025). The correct answer is The Earth’s rotation causes centrifugal force, which is maximum at the equator.

question: Read the statements and choose the correct answer i. Polar climate has very low temperature through out the year. ii. Subtropical climate has low temperature through out the year. iii. Tropical climate has high temperature through out the year. iv. Temperate climate has high temperature alternating with low temperature in winter.
options: i and ii wrong – iii and iv correct
ii and iii wrong – i and iv correct
ii and iv wrong – i and iii correct
iii and iv wrong – i and ii correct
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 06/2025 (Junior Instructor, 17 Jan 2025). The correct answer is ii and iv wrong – i and iii correct.
